title: Embrace imperfection / windblown portrait

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Allow incidental movement and imperfect framing to convey a lived human moment.
strategic_value: Unpolished imagery can support the authentic experience described in Instagram’s principle.
demonstration: A low-angle portrait shows hair blown across the frame against a cloudy sky, with no graphic overlays.
practical_value: Assess whether a photograph feels spontaneous through motion, framing and expression before adding branding.

content_islands.name: Windblown subject
content_islands.spec: Let the moving hair occupy much of the portrait field.

content_islands.name: Open sky
content_islands.spec: Retain the pale sky behind the head so the loose strands remain visible.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent Embrace imperfection text explicitly celebrates authentic, imperfect human experiences.
reference_purposes.Expression: The image demonstrates that principle through loose framing and visible movement.
